inputs.text: Original hand-painted albedo texture for a beautiful stylized 3D fantasy adventure, painterly brushwork with carefully designed large and medium shapes and small accents. An exactly flat orthographic material surface covering the entire square, a continuous repeating surface rather than an object or a scene. Soft diffuse intrinsic material colors, no directional light, no cast shadow, no ambient-occlusion frame, no gradient across the image, no vignette, no border, no text. Seamless on all four edges. Restrained contrast suited to viewing at 128 by 128 pixels; quiet broad areas between clusters, no gritty photographic noise. A lush meadow carpet in sunlit yellow-green, celadon and deeper olive. Deliberately painted curved short grass strokes in small irregular groups, tiny cream clover leaves and a few muted sage herbs. Grass covers every corner uniformly. The pattern has no central tuft and no individual large flowers. A botanical watercolor-gouache surface with legible brush-shaped blades, warm and welcoming.
